description: HTML source code for a web-based database viewer interface, including CSS styles and JavaScript for interaction and data loading via API calls.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables of a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table and inserts it into the DOM.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expansion of cell content to show full data.
